name: 定义 DTO 领域对象
description: 实现四个 DTO 结构体。AuditLogPage（items []AuditLog、total int、page int、page_size int，JSON 标签）。QueryAuditLogRequest（action/actor/resource_type *string、resource_id *int64、start_time/end_time *time.Time、page/page_size int，可选字段用指针区分未提供）。RecordAuditLogRequest（action/actor/resource_type string、resource_id *int64、detail json.RawMessage、timestamp time.Time）。RecordAuditLogResponse（log_id int64、recorded bool）。产出物: auditlogpage.go、queryauditlogrequest.go、recordauditlogrequest.go、recordauditlogresponse.go
